decision_source: user instruction (Photon channel), 2026-08-22: (1) rule amendment approved, (2) model = Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, (3) P1+P2 execution authorized

prohibited: training/tuning/ingestion/leakage of benchmark-family data into the backbone
silent substitution of the backbone for HENRI wave machinery in live HENRI paths
official AAII v4.1 composite score claims without canonical dataset + evaluator chain
required_controls: frozen backbone-only baseline mandatory (eval mode, zero trainable params)
every HENRI augmentation requires a matched ablation against the unchanged backbone
augmentation must not reduce aggregate baseline score
provenance validation: immutable HF revision + per-shard SHA-256 manifest
all benchmark-family held-out status labeled CONDITIONAL unless provenance proves exclusion

scope: P2: dependency provisioning on cloud GPU + bounded public baseline with run-evidence receipts
stop_conditions_p2: unexplained OOM or silent CPU/disk offload during baseline timing
